name: yisus-develop/eweb-cf7-signature
description: Digital signature (HTML5 canvas) field for Contact Form 7 with sandboxed PNG storage, inline e-mail images and a native mPDF bridge.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Check the coding standards (WordPress-Core, Extra and Docs).
scripts-descriptions.lint:summary: Check the coding standards and print a per-file summary.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Fix the coding standards violations that can be fixed automatically.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the smoke test suite (no WordPress required).
scripts-descriptions.test:contract: Verify the Contact Form 7 contract against an installed copy.
